speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the sensation of dizziness you're experiencing—does it feel like the room is spinning around you, or do you feel lightheaded and faint? Also, how long do these episodes typically last?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text: Do these dizzy spells last for less than a minute, and do they worsen when you turn over in bed or look up? I also need to know if you have any hearing loss or ringing in your ears that fluctuates with the dizziness.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Episodes of dizziness and spinning sensation. I also have Position dependent vertigo, No recent illness, No hearing loss besides presbycusis.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Positive for right-sided horizontal nystagmus when moving from sitting to supine position, suggestive of BPPV

speaker: Doctor
